title: About
paragraph1: I build backend services and their cloud infrastructure. At Veltra, I work on Python, Go, and Node services on AWS, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations and internal AI tools.
paragraph2: Earlier, I built and operated Go, Ruby, and Python systems in logistics, fintech, medical IT, and games. Based in Tokyo since 2004, I work between overseas and Japan teams in English and Japanese.
languagesContent: Turkish (Native), English (Near Native; TOEFL 263 on the old CBT scale, 2004), Japanese (Business; JLPT Level 2, 2006)
